notes:
Snapshot of account: QuantumRun builds low-latency personalization & reranking for large-scale ad auctions and content feeds. Primary ask: predictably low p95 latency under heavy concurrent load while keeping unit cost competitive.

Key technical targets (from SE call):
- Workload: mixed short-chat + reranking requests; median token length small (5-40 tokens) but QPS bursts up to ~4k sustained, spiking to 8k.
- Latency targets: p50 < 20ms, p95 < 60ms, p99 < 120ms for typical prompts (cold/warm split important).
- Throughput target: 3k-5k concurrent requests with 65% prefix reuse (cacheable).
- Cost sensitivity: looking to be below ~$0.04 per 1k tokens equivalent (hosting & inference combined) or justify uplift via latency SLOs.
- Model preference: open/quantizable models; willing to run 4-bit/8-bit quantized variants if quality holds. Requests quantization comparison bench (fp16 vs 8-bit vs 4-bit).
- Optimizations wanted: batching profiles for short sequence distribution, KV/prefix caching effectiveness, adaptive routing (hot vs cold), and quantization tradeoffs.

POC scope requested by customer: 2-week performance benchmark + 2-week integration pilot. Benchmarks to include:
- p50/p95/p99 latency matrix across 3 models + quantization profiles
- Cold vs warm KV cache runs with % prefix reuse scenarios (20/40/65/80%)
- Batching experiments: optimal batch size vs latency SLOs for that request mix
- Cost model: per-token and per-request cost projection for Dedicated pool at target throughput

Customer quotes: "If we can get consistent p95 under 60ms at scale and keep cost predictable, we switch."

- Legal: needs explicit data residency clause for EU workloads, export control check for on-prem option.
- Infra: wants example Terraform and K8s manifests for Dedicated + VPC peering diagram.
- Bench data: SE requested sample traffic trace from QuantRun (sanitized) to simulate real prefix reuse patterns.

Immediate asks for Redwood:
- Provide perf bench plan + timeline and cost estimate by 2026-03-05.
- Share runbook for batching and cache config (examples).
- Provide quantization whitepaper / eval checklist and sample results vs accuracy baseline.

Other notes: SE (Priya) to run initial bench with 3 model variants. Finance asked for annualized ARR and committed Dedicated pool delta. Customer is impatient on turnaround - called it a "fast yes/no POC".
